context.title: Load existing context
context.imperative: Read any existing docs/agents/*, AGENTS.md, and the README/overview. Attest c1.

intent.title: Capture project intent
intent.imperative: Ask the user the project's overall intent and current development status, unless already given. Record it.

explore.title: Explore existing code
explore.imperative: If the project has code, briefly explore it to learn what is implemented. Record findings. Skip with reason if greenfield.

postconditions.statement: current implementation understood at a high level

interrogate.title: Interrogate doctrine
interrogate.imperative: Synthesize what is known into a handoff (the goal: how the project wants problems approached, special crew rules, posture, standards, terms). Hand it with the charter starting questions to a subagent that invokes constellation-interrogator; integrate the resolved understanding from interrogation.json.

orchestrator-context.title: Write ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT
orchestrator-context.imperative: Write docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md (planning, authority, gating, evidence, stop/ask). Confirm it with the user.

crew-context.title: Write CREW_CONTEXT
crew-context.imperative: Write docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md (implementation, verification, review/blocking, stop/report). Confirm it with the user.

glossary.title: Write GLOSSARY
glossary.imperative: Write docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md (shared terms only). Confirm it with the user.

engine-config.title: Write engine config
engine-config.imperative: Write docs/agents/engine-config.json (rework cap, rigor checkpoints, rules root, repo guidance). Confirm it with the user.

project-templates.title: Seed project templates
project-templates.imperative: Seed or update .agent-work/templates/ with project-specific template versions where the project needs them (e.g. project review criteria). Skip with reason if none needed.

closeout.title: Compile and archive
closeout.imperative: Confirm durable outputs updated, no open questions remain, contradiction pass done. Archive the work area.

postconditions.statement: durable outputs complete; work area archived
